enabled.title: Enable channel monitoring
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, periodic checks halt and the user-facing /channel-status view returns an empty list.

defaultIntervalSec.title: Default check interval (seconds)
defaultIntervalSec.description: Pre-filled in the admin Create form. Per-monitor override still applies.

templateMaxBodyKB.title: Max template body size (KB)
templateMaxBodyKB.description: Upper bound for body_override JSON size on request templates.

dailyRollupHourUTC.title: Daily rollup hour (UTC, 0-23)
dailyRollupHourUTC.description: Informational — the host cron currently fires at 02:00 UTC. Reserved for future per-tenant overrides.
dailyRollupHourUTC.x-deprecated: Reserved for future use; current cron is hard-coded to 02:00 UTC. Will be repurposed in V7.

internalUpstreamProbeKey.title: Internal upstream probe key (DEMO secret)
internalUpstreamProbeKey.description: Demo of x-visibility:secret. Used only for SETTINGS-V2 smoke testing — leave empty in production.

_internalCacheTTLSec.title: Internal monitor cache TTL (seconds)
_internalCacheTTLSec.description: Backend-only — controls in-memory monitor cache TTL. Not editable from admin UI. Demo of x-visibility:backend.

availableChannelsEnabled.title: Enable available channels view
availableChannelsEnabled.description: Soft switch for the user-facing /available-channels endpoint and sidebar entry. When off, the endpoint returns an empty list after auth and the sidebar entry is hidden. Defaults to false (opt-in).
